newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey in 25-year, $13.5 bln gas deal with Gazprom.
newsitem.headline: Turkey in 25-year, $13.5 bln gas deal with Gazprom.

text.p: Turkey signed a landmark agreement with Russia'a gas giant Gazprom to get natural gas worth a total of $13.5 billion over 25 years from 1997, senior Turkish officials said on Monday.

"The total value of the project is about $13.5 billion and it is a 25-year agreement starting from this year," Mustafa Murathan, head of Turkey's state pipeline concern Botas, told reporters after signing the deal with Gazprom head Rem Vyahirev in Istanbul.
Vyahirev said the deal would enable Turkey to receive Russian gas, presently at six billion cubic metres (bcm) annually, at gradually increasing amounts, reaching 30 bcm by 2010.

"This is final stage of the big project that we have begun some time ago. The sums involved in this agreement are really big sums. We are going to increase the present six bcm to 30 bcm by 2010," he told reporters.
